definitions.explanation: Wood that has been processed for use as a building material or in manufacturing. Refers to cut and prepared wood rather than living trees.

examples.japanese: {木材|もくざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国産|こくさん}→国産：12017_kokusan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{木材|もくざい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{建|た}てられた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: This house was built with domestic timber.

examples.japanese: ⟦{違法|いほう}→違法：09687_ihou⟧な⟦{森林|しんりん}{伐採|ばっさい}→森林伐採：09285_shinrinbassai⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{木材|もくざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{輸出|ゆしゅつ}→輸出：02094_yushutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になっている。
examples.english: The export of timber from illegal logging has become a problem.

notes:
USAGE:
Refers specifically to processed wood used as material. For trees as living plants, use ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧. For wood as a general material concept, ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧ or ⟦{木製|もくせい}→木製：13083_mokusei_b⟧ (made of wood) may also be used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {木材|もくざい}⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧: wood processing
- {木材|もくざい}⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧: timber dealer
- ⟦{国産|こくさん}→国産：12017_kokusan⟧{木材|もくざい}: domestic timber
- ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧{木材|もくざい}: construction lumber
- {木材|もくざい}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: timber prices
